name: comet-convert
title: Comet Convert
description: Open your current browser tab (right now coded for Microsoft Edge) in Comet browser and vice versa
author: vvcdev

commands.name: open-in-comet
commands.title: Edge to Comet
commands.description: Open current Microsoft Edge tab in Comet browser

commands.name: open-in-edge
commands.title: Comet to Edge
commands.description: Open current Comet tab in Microsoft Edge

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
